name: When should I coordinate countertop installation during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should I coordinate countertop installation during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's best to coordinate countertop installation after cabinet installation is complete, but before plumbing or final appliance hook-ups. This sequence ensures accurate measurements can be taken from the newly installed cabinets, allowing for a precise fit. We can integrate our services seamlessly into your overall kitchen remodel timeline in the Berkeley, East Bay, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coordinate after cabinets are installed, but before plumbing or final appliance hook-ups.
